events.note: Authored for credential-evidence#246 (E2) from the cited provider pages; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#246, on the owner's instruction of 2026-10-05 to take maintainer-only decisions for this work. Question: a value in the X-JFrog-Art-API header or in the basic-authentication password position to an Artifactory host is a credential whatever its shape? Options: require a documented prefix, alphabet or width (JFrog's two documented forms are not reconciled and its client code names a narrower prefix) or flag only one recognised shape; or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag any value in those two positions, no key type inferred (reference tokens use the same positions). Reason: The provider pages document only that the carriers exist and that reference tokens share them, not a value format, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The provider pages document the carriers but no settled value format, so a position-only rule can flag non-secrets or miss a differently shaped secret, and the same positions carry a different credential type; leaving the case a draft would claim nothing.
events.reversingEvidence: A JFrog statement of the key format or of the carriers' confidentiality that contradicts this outcome, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
